# Day 1: LangGraph 개요와 설치
from typing_extensions import TypedDict
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, START, END

class State(TypedDict):
    value: str

def study_node(state: State):
    # TODO: LangGraph 개요와 설치 개념을 적용하세요.

builder.add_edge(START, "study")
builder.add_edge("study", END)
graph = builder.compile()
print(graph.invoke({"value": "start"}))

from typing_extensions import TypedDict
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, START
class InputState(TypedDict): text: str
class OutputState(TypedDict): length: int
class OverallState(InputState, OutputState): pass
def measure(state: InputState) -> OutputState: return {"length": len(state["text"])}
b = StateGraph(OverallState, input_schema=InputState, output_schema=OutputState)
b.add_node(measure); b.add_edge(START, "measure")
print(b.compile().invoke({"text": "LangGraph"}))

from dataclasses import dataclass
from langgraph.runtime import Runtime
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, START
from typing_extensions import TypedDict

from typing_extensions import TypedDict
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, START, END
class PublicState(TypedDict): request: str; response: str
class InternalState(TypedDict): secret: str
def prepare(state: PublicState) -> InternalState: return {"secret": state["request"].upper()}
def respond(state: InternalState): return {"response": f"processed:{state['secret']}"}
b = StateGraph(PublicState); b.add_node("prepare", prepare); b.add_node("respond", respond)
b.add_edge(START, "prepare"); b.add_edge("prepare", "respond"); b.add_edge("respond", END)
print(b.compile().invoke({"request": "hello", "response": ""}))

# Day 54: Command와 Send: 테스트와 디버깅 예시 풀이
from typing_extensions import TypedDict
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, START, END

class State(TypedDict):

builder.add_edge(START, "study")

graph = builder.compile()

# Day 160: 프로젝트: 콘텐츠 제작 멀티 에이전트 시스템 예시 풀이
from typing_extensions import TypedDict
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, START, END

class State(TypedDict):
    value: str
    history: list[str]

def study_node(state: State):
    return {"value": f"프로젝트: 콘텐츠 제작 멀티 에이전트 시스템 완료", "history": [*state.get("history", []), "프로젝트: 콘텐츠 제작 멀티 에이전트 시스템"]}

builder = StateGraph(State)
builder.add_node("study", study_node)
builder.add_edge(START, "study")
builder.add_edge("study", END)
graph = builder.compile()
print(graph.invoke({"value": "start", "history": []}))
